commits.message: Name the published-lifecycle prefix the run-shared fixture directory holds
Describe the working-ledger rebuild's upsert by its mechanism
Merge colll78/l1-n1u into the L1 integration branch
Document the node instance-lock readiness reasons
Merge colll78/l1-n1x into the L1 integration branch
Merge colll78/l1-n1close2 into the L1 integration branch

Follow the emulator chain with one node follower store

The emulator's confirmed blocks are recorded once per change of its block
height and applied once, through the follower store's own writer, to the
node's Postgres follower store. NodeL1Provider, the follower-change
driver's plan and the landed-queue read all read that store. A ledger
put back without its record drops the blocks whose consumed outputs it
holds again. Each block widens the tracked set by the script
credentials, the key credentials outside the origin wallets and the
policies it shows. The store is emptied when the installation is
restored.

The synthetic follower view and tip are removed from the emulator
paths, along with the unused live-orders helper. Every emulator suite
that used either now runs on the store. The installed afterAll still
checks that a transaction confirmed and that the store holds exactly the
confirmed set. The deposit-flow submission suite's gate-refusal case is
removed: it assumed follower tables without the operator's wallet. The
commit-gate emulator suite refuses an untracked input on a store fed
real blocks. Duration rows, the Postgres inventory and module-size caps
are updated.
Merge colll78/l1-docs into the L1 integration branch

Take a node instance lock at startup and replay pending txs in causal order

The node takes a Postgres session advisory lock before database
initialization, lease release, mutation-job classification and the
follower driver. The lock's session also holds the follower's writer
lease, which the node lends to its follower store. A second process
waits, unready under node_instance_lock_held_elsewhere (or
node_instance_lock_unavailable), and retries with backoff; the wait
stops at once on interrupt. When the holding session ends under a live
node, node_instance_lock_suspended holds commit, settlement, merge and
watchdog until the lock is taken again. The committee store lock is now
an adapter over the same shared module.

The working-ledger rebuild replays pending transactions by time stamp,
then admission order (tx_admissions.arrival_seq), then id, and places
each pending producer before any transaction that spends its output,
so a child is never replayed before its parent. Dead rebuild helpers
are removed.

Adds tests for both lock polarities, the replay order, kept-row time
stamps, and the funded-transfer journey after a deposit leaves the
chain.

Delete the node's event-history control plane

The L1 follower's facts and the follower-change driver now carry every duty
of the event-history owner: ingestion, the commit horizon and the
unpublished-ledger requeue. Delete the owner, its authority lease, the Ogmios
ChainSync journal, the replay and L2 ledger receipts, the recovery plans, the
history-genesis pin and the node's Kupo/Ogmios readers. Migration 0022 drops
their ten tables, children first and without CASCADE; the submission journal
stays.

The node reads and submits L1 only through the cardano-node socket.
L1_OGMIOS_KEY, L1_KUPO_KEY and L1_HISTORY_GENESIS_LOSSLESS_SHA256 are gone.
Ogmios and Kupo stay in the compose overlay for the devnet harness, its
stop-kupo/stop-ogmios drills and the fault-proofs prover; the harness readers
move to midgard-node-tools. Five emulator tests leave the event-history
namespace under new names. A grep-gate test refuses any return of the deleted
modules, tables, keys or command.

Refs #799

Document node readiness reasons and reconcile docs with the L1 follower

Every reason the node can put in /readyz now has operator text in the devnet endpoints reference, and scripts/ci/check-readiness-reasons-doc.mjs derives the reasons from the node source and fails when one is missing. Committee, watcher, transport and node docs describe the current behaviour: the committee and retention sweeper stay up and report readiness instead of exiting, tx_rejection_causes is documented, the transport checks block bodies, and watcher startup, journal and objective-cleanup behaviour matches the code. The plan records whole-file journal rollback as an accepted residual. Registry entries for deleted modules are dropped, and dated records citing deleted files are marked historical.
Merge N1H: move event-history runtime duties onto the follower-change driver

Move event-history runtime duties onto the follower-change driver

Writes that derive from the L1 view now run the follower view check in
their own transaction and take the node_follower_write_gate row (migration
0021) under a permit at the driver's applied view and gate epoch. A stale
view, a pending driver recompute or a superseded epoch is a named hold
the caller retries; the held error names its reason.

The driver hosts the landed-block rebase and folds orphan repair into its
recompute, re-projecting events the rebase released. The recompute reads
follower event entries instead of the receipt-member tables, which are
retired along with ledger repair. Startup preparation runs once after the
follower catches up; a failure is the startup_preparation_failed hold with
retry rather than an exit.

The settlement fence and tx-status merge evidence read the gate. /readyz
names the gate's reasons (l1_follower_view_unapplied,
l1_driver_recompute_pending, l1_driver_recompute_failed) and the
follower's own; historyOwnerStopped and the history_owner_not_ready,
history_follower_lagging, history_sync and history_initialization reasons
are removed. node-tools reads the deployment manifest from node_deployment
instead of the ledger snapshot module. A module-graph test keeps runtime
entry points off the event-history owner modules.
Merge N1K2: run each emulator family suite once, follower-hosted

Delete the follower-provider suite wrappers

Each wrapped emulator family suite now runs follower-hosted itself, so the 25 wrappers only re-ran it.
